summary: Experienced Software Engineer with X+ years of experience building scalable web applications and distributed systems. Proficient in **Java**, **Python**, and **TypeScript** with a strong background in **cloud infrastructure** and **microservices architecture**. Proven track record of delivering high-quality software in fast-paced environments.
coreCompetencies: **Backend Development**: Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Python. Familiar with event-driven architectures and message queues.
**Frontend Development**: Proficient in React, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks. Experience building responsive, accessible user interfaces.
**Cloud & Infrastructure**: Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Docker, and Kubernetes. Familiar with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
**Data Engineering**: Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), data pipelines, and ETL processes. Familiarity with Apache Spark and data warehousing concepts.
**DevOps & CI/CD**: Proficient in Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and automated testing. Experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog and Grafana.
**Collaboration & Leadership**: Strong communicator with experience mentoring junior developers, leading code reviews, and participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.

highlights: **Microservices Migration**: Led the decomposition of a monolithic application into microservices, improving deployment frequency by 3x and reducing incident response time by 40%.
**API Design**: Designed and implemented RESTful APIs serving 1M+ requests per day with 99.9% uptime.
**Performance Optimization**: Identified and resolved critical performance bottlenecks, reducing average response time from 500ms to 50ms.
**Mentorship**: Mentored a team of 3 junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical design sessions.
**Feature Development**: Built and shipped customer-facing features across the full stack, contributing to a 20% increase in user engagement.
**CI/CD Pipeline**: Designed and implemented a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes.
**Database Optimization**: Optimized slow SQL queries and implemented indexing strategies, reducing average query time by 60%.
**Testing**: Increased test coverage from 45% to 85% by introducing integration tests and contract testing.
**Full-Stack Development**: Developed features across a Node.js backend and React frontend for an early-stage SaaS product.
**Third-Party Integrations**: Integrated payment processing (Stripe) and email services (SendGrid) into the platform.
**Agile Practices**: Participated in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives as part of a small Agile team.
